name: Kemono Naki Yoru no Ori nite
source:
A world inhabited by two distinct races: humans and half-beasts.

Told from the perspective of a certain man visiting a brothel in a lawless desert town, this is a narrative-driven visual novel with a dark, Arabian flair. Converse with a rabbit-eared half-human prostitute, listen to her bedtime stories, and engage in various intimate activities together.

Spend three nights in her company, and the secrets of this world—its history, its background, and the grim, gruesome events that lie beneath the surface—may slowly begin to unravel before your eyes.

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/8974]Novelgame[/url]]
translation:
一个居住着两个不同种族的世界：人类和半兽。

这是一部叙事驱动的视觉小说，从一个在无法无天的沙漠小镇参观妓院的男人的角度讲述，带有黑暗的阿拉伯风格。与兔耳半人妓女交谈，听她的睡前故事，一起进行各种亲密活动。

在她的陪伴下度过三个晚上，这个世界的秘密——它的历史、它的背景，以及隐藏在表面之下的严峻、可怕的事件——可能会慢慢地开始在你眼前揭开。

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/8974]Novelgame[/url]]
